The art of Weaving is twofold: first and foremost, it is the practice of forging weapons from the substance of Creation, calling to your hand a blade or mace and dismissing it as soon as its work is done.
 
Second, it is the means by which a practitioner may begin the return to Creation of a foe, unweaving their mortal shell and consigning them to a grim fate.

The skill of '''Weaving''' is available to members of the [[Psion]] [[class]], along with [[Psionics]] and [[Emulation]].

{{Skill_detail

 |lessons=

 |required=
 |target=Adventurers and denizens
 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Overhand
 |description=Bring them down with a crushing blow.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE OVERHAND <target>
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers and denizens
 |cooldown=2.20 seconds of balance
 |detail=Deliver a crushing overhand blow with a mace.<p>If the target is already knocked to the ground, this blow will rattle their skull so much that they will become impatient; if they are not, they will be knocked to the ground and suffer from a bout of stupidity.</p><p>In addition, impatience will be delivered if this blow also breaks the target's head with the strike, or if their head is already broken.</p>

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Hamstring
 |description=They won't be walking that off.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE HAMSTRING <target> [LEFT{{!}}RIGHT]
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers and denizens
 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance
 |detail=Using a dagger, you will slice at the hamstring in a target's leg. This will cause the leg to be broken if it's in a good condition(*), and cause the target to fall prone if it is not(**).<p>* Will deliver broken left or right leg if the targeted leg is not damaged to the point of requiring a restoration salve.<br>** Will knock them prone if the leg is damaged to the point of requiring a restoration salve.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Entwine

 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE ENTWINE <target>
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance

}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Prepare
 |description=Modify your creations.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE PREPARE <DISRUPTION{{!}}LACERATION{{!}}DAZZLE{{!}}RATTLE{{!}}VAPOURS{{!}}NONE>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=<p>You may now prepare a modification to future weaves. Preparing a modification lasts indefinitely: you do not need to re-prepare every time you seek to attack. Preparing a new modification will remove the previous one, and you may stop preparing any modifications at all by specifying to prepare NONE or NOTHING.</p><p>'''Disruption''': this preparation will cause your attacks to give paralysis.<br>'''Laceration''': this preparation will cause your attacks to give haemophilia.<br>'''Dazzle''': This preparation will cause your attacks to give clumsiness.<br>'''Rattle''': this preparation will cause your attacks to give epilepsy.<br>'''Vapours''': this preparations will cause your attacks to deliver asthma.<br>'''Incisive''': you will deliver no affliction, but your strike will possess such clarity as to not miss due to being excessively clumsy.<br>'''Insubstantial''': your attacks bypass auras of rebounding and reflections (but do not strip them).
}}

{{Skill_detail

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Unweave
 |description=From dust to dust.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE UNWEAVE <target> <BODY{{!}}MIND{{!}}SPIRIT>
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance
 |detail=Begin the process of unweaving part of an individual's fundamental essence. Each type of unweaving has separate effects and the longer the unweaving process persists, the more deadly these effects become:<p>'''Body''': health loss whenever the unweaving proceeds.<br>'''Mind''': mana loss whenever the weaving proceeds.<br>'''Spirit''': each time the unweaving proceeds, an additional cure is required to cure the spirit unweave. This is unique to the spirit unweave.

 |lessons=

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Backhand

 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE BACKHAND <target>

 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Invert
 |description=A slight change of pace.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE INVERT <target> <old weave> <new weave>
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance
 |detail=Invert your unweavings on a target, swapping one weaves status for another. For instance, invert your targets body and spirit weaves, and the spirit weave gains the progression of the body weave and the body weave gains the progression of the spirit weave.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Rally

 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE RALLY
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance
 |detail=Weave power into your very voice, enabling you to shout a rallying cry(*), healing yourself for a large amount of health(**). You can only do this every so often, as it is somewhat taxing.<p>* This uses your warcry if you have one set.<br>** This can push your health above your maximum.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Exsanguinate
 |description=They'll never eat again.
 |lessons=

 |required=
 |target=Adventurers and denizens
 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance
 |detail=By driving your blade into the guts of your foe, you'll ravage their internal organs, making them violently sick(*). If they're already bleeding significantly then they'll also lose any desire (or ability) to eat(**).<p>* Gives nausea.<br>** Gives anorexia.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Deconstruct

 |lessons=

 |required=

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Miriad
 |description=We are legion.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=WEAVE MIRIAD<br>WEAVE MIRIAD DISPERSE<br>MIRIADS
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=2.30 seconds of balance
 |detail=The ultimate expression of weaving: weaving copies of your own person into being. These copies shall attach themselves to random targets in your location, and whenever you hit an individual those copies shall copy you on their relevant targets. You do not get to choose the targets and the miriads will only work when they can see both you and their target(*). Miriads do the same limb damage and afflictions as you, but their health damage is significantly reduced(**).<p>* You must be in the same room as the target of the miriad.<br>** 50% of base values.</p>
}}
